name: nxonaut
description: Let Claude model, inspect and export in Siemens NX: parts, sketches, assemblies with constraints, drawings and STEP export.
long_description:
NXonaut is a community MCP server for Siemens NX (Windows). Claude works next to you in NX: it creates parts and sketches, builds assemblies with constraints, measures and checks clearances, makes drawings and exports STEP, PDF or DXF.

**Start it in NX once:** after installing, press Alt+F8 in NX and play `Start NXonaut.py` from your workspace folder (default `C:\Users\<you>\NX_MCP_WORKSPACE`). With *Start with NX* switched on, NX starts it by itself after the next NX restart. A small NX MCP panel shows what Claude does.

Claude changes only parts it created, or parts you allow on the panel, and reads and writes files only in the workspace folder.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Siemens; you need your own licensed NX. Builds on skyf0l/siemens-nx-mcp, DreamEnding/NX_MCP, xuio/NX_MCP and LT60/nx-agent (MIT).

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: The only folder Claude reads and writes files in (parts, exports). NX uses the same one. Leave empty for C:\Users\<you>\NX_MCP_WORKSPACE.

nx_autostart.title: Start with NX
nx_autostart.description: Let NX start NXonaut by itself (sets UGII_USER_DIR, only if you do not use it already).
